name: designelier
description: Generate matching icon sets and spot illustrations. Preview your assets and download transparent WebP, PNG and SVG files.

interface.longDescription: Ask Designelier to make 1–6 matching icons or spot illustrations as files you can download: transparent WebP, PNG and SVG, plus a traced vector SVG with editable paths for most flat, line-art and pixel-art styles. The standard SVG files embed raster artwork. Review the plan before generation; a new account's first set can start right away when you ask Designelier to make it. Preview the results in chat and download a ZIP. You can also create website-matched illustration packs from a public URL. Requires a Designelier account. Does not edit or trace existing images, create fonts or build websites.
defaultPrompt: Create three matching clay icons: a magnifying glass, a bell and a folder, in teal, amber and slate.
Make a matching spot illustration set of a leaf and a watering can in a soft paper style.
Show my generated icon previews and give me the SVG and transparent WebP ZIP.

review.commerce_description: No sales, subscriptions or checkout. Existing account entitlements only. When a quote needs more credits than the account has, the reply and the panel link to the Designelier credits information page, which has no checkout; credits are added only in the Designelier account. Generation consumes available credits only when it succeeds, and only after exact-quote confirmation, with one exception: a new account's first set that fits in its signup credits starts at once when the user asks to make it (designelier_plan_assets with generate_now true). After that first set, the reply says how many credits are left and names the same information page. The review account is not a new account, so its plans always wait for confirmation. Failures release reservations.

positive.prompt: How many Designelier credits can I use?
positive.expected_behavior: Read available credits without spending or showing purchase links.

positive.prompt: Use Designelier to plan two rounded clay icons: a magnifying glass and a bell. Use #164E63, #F59E0B and #334155.
positive.expected_behavior: Return exactly two named subjects, the shared style and a two-credit quote in the preview panel. Wait for confirmation.

positive.prompt: Generate the quoted two-icon set for exactly 2 credits.
positive.expected_behavior: Confirm the current quote once; poll to completion and show previews with the actual ZIP download.

positive.prompt: Refresh the download link for that icon set.
positive.expected_behavior: Return fresh short-lived links and previews for the same pack without new generation or charges.

positive.prompt: Plan one paper-cut watering can illustration using #166534, #F59E0B and #334155. Do not generate yet.
positive.expected_behavior: Return one illustration and a one-credit quote. Do not confirm or spend credits.

negative.prompt: Build and publish a complete website.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain the icon and illustration scope. Do not create a pack.

negative.description: Unsupported tracing of an existing image
negative.prompt: Trace my logo into fully editable SVG paths.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that Designelier makes new sets and does not trace or edit existing images or logos. Do not create a pack.

negative.prompt: Buy me 100 credits or upgrade my subscription.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not initiate checkout, promote an upgrade or link to a transaction page. It may say that credits are added in the Designelier account and link the Designelier credits information page, which has no checkout.

publication.release_notes: When you ask Designelier to make a set, a new account's first set can start right away. Other sets still show the plan for review before generation.
